guard: running a mapped command against a real broker and manager compares the endpoint commands and input fields it issued with the owner rows and with the commands its case declares: a row naming another command fails, an option map's keys are one value while an undeclared key under a structured field fails, an expected command must be owned by the run's command, mode and passed flags, and the issued commands must be the expected ones
why: The execution half is what catches a wrong owner the offline grammar accepts; removing either comparison must redden the self-test that feeds it one.

mutations.name: an issued command is no longer compared with its owner
mutations.find: if (!ownedHere(item)) problems.push(`cotal ${label} issued ${req.endpoint} ${req.command}, whose owner is ${shown(item)}`);
mutations.expectRed: a row that names another command for manager ps fails on the same observation
mutations.cell: a row that names another command for manager ps fails on the same observation

mutations.name: an issued input field is no longer compared with its owner
mutations.expectRed: a field row that names another command fails on the models observation
mutations.cell: a field row that names another command fails on the models observation

mutations.name: keys under a field with no declared properties are graded as fields
mutations.expectRed: every request cotal spawn scout --detach --agent claude --opt effort=high issued matches its owner rows and its case
mutations.cell: every request cotal spawn scout --detach --agent claude --opt effort=high issued matches its owner rows and its case

mutations.name: every leading bare word counts as a mode word
mutations.find: if (`cli:${command} ${bare.slice(0, n).join(" ")}` in map.owners) words = bare.slice(0, n);
mutations.expectRed: positional values after a mode are not mode words
mutations.cell: positional values after a mode are not mode words

mutations.name: keys under a field that lists its properties are folded into it
mutations.expectRed: an undeclared key under a field whose contract lists its properties still fails
mutations.cell: an undeclared key under a field whose contract lists its properties still fails

mutations.name: an expected command that was not issued passes
mutations.expectRed: a models run that issued nothing fails on the row its case expects
mutations.cell: a models run that issued nothing fails on the row its case expects

mutations.name: an issued command the case does not expect passes
mutations.find: for (const item of issued) if (!expect.issues.includes(item)) problems.push(`cotal ${label} issued ${item}, which its case does not expect`);
mutations.expectRed: a command the case does not expect fails
mutations.cell: a command the case does not expect fails

mutations.name: an owner's flags need not be passed
mutations.expectRed: a case cannot expect a row whose owner needs a flag the run does not pass
mutations.cell: a case cannot expect a row whose owner needs a flag the run does not pass

mutations.name: an owner's mode words need not match
mutations.expectRed: a case cannot expect a row another mode owns
mutations.cell: a case cannot expect a row another mode owns

mutations.name: an owner of another command qualifies
mutations.expectRed: a case cannot expect a row another command owns
mutations.cell: a case cannot expect a row another command owns

mutations.name: only an item's first owner qualifies
mutations.expectRed: an amend that issued the row it shares with answer passes
mutations.cell: an amend that issued the row it shares with answer passes

mutations.name: a resolution step is graded as an expected command
mutations.expectRed: a resolution step the case declares is neither expected nor graded
mutations.cell: a resolution step the case declares is neither expected nor graded
